title: arctostaphylos tomentosa subsp. tomentosiformis
intro: Arctostaphylos tomentosa subsp. tomentosiformis, commonly known as Island Manzanita, is a shrub species native to the Channel Islands of California. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to make a tea, known as Island tea, which has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Island Manzanita include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating conditions such as fever, sore throats, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which have been shown to have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
